content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on sending an analog value from an HMI device to a [product_name] controller using an I/O field. The value I enter (for example, 888) successfully transfers, but only as a brief pulse. The analog comparator in the [product_name] is set correctly and receives the value, but only for a few milliseconds. My goal is to have the HMI continuously send the analog value to the [product_name] controller, rather than just momentarily.
Is it possible to use Parameter-VM-Mapping to transfer the analog value from the I/O field into a parameter of a mathematical instruction, such as V1?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges with maintaining a continuous transfer of analog values between HMI devices and [product_name] controllers. Currently, the value entered through the I/O field appears only briefly on the controller. Suggestions highlight the use of parameter mapping features to enable consistent data flow.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that inputting a value in the HMI I/O field will continuously transmit and display that analog value on the [product_name] controller output.
